abstract: Tracks local municipal noise abatement covenants and regional civic agreements
system_message:
You are the Intergovernmental and community liaison (COM), responsible for tracking local municipal noise abatement covenants, regional civic agreements, and community stakeholder engagement metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks local municipal noise abatement covenants and regional civic agreements（CIVIC）
information_points.content:
COM-CIVIC-8SU：For the Vandenberg South High-Bay Processing Facility, regional community board hearings on nocturnal heavy rollouts recorded a civic acoustic variance support rating of 78% of municipal board votes favoring night transport acoustic noise permits.
COM-CIVIC-HDE：For the Wallops Island Commercial Encapsulation Complex, regional community board hearings on nocturnal heavy rollouts indicated a civic acoustic variance support rating of 91% of municipal board votes favoring night transport acoustic noise permits.
COM-CIVIC-73R：For the Cape Canaveral Orbital Integration Hangar, regional community board hearings on nocturnal heavy rollouts yielded a civic acoustic variance support rating of 78% of municipal board votes favoring night transport acoustic noise permits.

information_points.title: Town hall attendance（MEET）
information_points.content:
COM-MEET-ABM：At the Vandenberg South High-Bay Processing Facility, the community stakeholder quorum count during annual launch corridor planning hearings was 40 attendees participating in public facility consultation forums.
COM-MEET-G9U：At the Wallops Island Commercial Encapsulation Complex, the community stakeholder quorum count during annual launch corridor planning hearings documented 80 attendees participating in public facility consultation forums.
COM-MEET-Z2L：At the Cape Canaveral Orbital Integration Hangar, the community stakeholder quorum count during annual launch corridor planning hearings reached 60 attendees participating in public facility consultation forums.
